title: hepetis alborubra
intro: Hepetis alborubra, commonly known as Chinese jasmine or White Jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the family Oleaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Hepetis alborubra include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
